text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I did it… I got first place.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I closed more of that distance between us… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hehe… It's nice to feel the same way about something…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best next time as well…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll win, and we'll be able to share this feeling again…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: After all, I still don't have what it takes to close that gap…
